text: Dusk keeps hunting for a way to get Reed alone — cistern, then baker's stall — while Reed keeps saying no and dragging everyone into the open instead. Vale's sluice gate check comes back clean again, and Flint's still convinced Vale's chasing distractions, so the group regroups at the market fountain to cool off. Meanwhile the Iron District keeps getting weirder: the smell's worse, people have gone dead silent, and Flint's now openly wondering what's being covered up over there.
